messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up — launching a small update to our PTO flows effective Apr 1. Two main changes:

Maya (People Ops): 1) Same-day auto-approval: for unplanned urgent time off up to 8 hours, employees can mark themselves OOO in the People Ops form and it will be auto-approved (managers get an FYI). This is to reduce friction for short-notice emergencies.

Maya (People Ops): 2) Flex carryover credits: instead of 'use-it-or-lose-it' you get a one-time flex credit pool of up to 5 days you can carry into the next fiscal year; you can apply them as partial-day or full-day blocks.

Maya (People Ops): A few quick clarifications: contractors and temps are not in scope; Private deployment / regional payroll differences exist (we'll show flags on the request form); managers can still request a retro review if they think abuse occurred.

Jason K: Nice. Does same-day auto-approve apply across time zones? If I'm on APAC hours and mark myself midday, does EMEA manager still get a notification?

Maya (People Ops): Good q — yes, notifications are local-time aware. The auto-approval window is based on the employee's local date. Managers always get an email + Slack FYI in their timezone.

Linh T: If someone auto-approves, do we still need to log it on team calendars so others know we're OOO?

Maya (People Ops): Please yes — automated calendar updates are part of the workflow but still rely on the employee to push to their primary team calendar. We're adding a calendar-sync button on the form this week.

Marcos: Is there an audit trail for auto-approved events? For compliance we need to show justification in some cases.

Maya (People Ops): Yep — every auto-approved request will include a short 'reason' text and a system tag 'auto-approve' stored in the audit log. People Ops can export for reviews.

Harper: Any change to carryover payout at termination? Like if someone leaves with carried days.

Maya (People Ops): No change — termination payout still follows your local employment law. Carryover days move into the next fiscal year balance and are subject to the usual payout rules per region.

Priya: How does this interact with the sabbatical policy? Can you trigger a sabbatical if you used carryover days?

Maya (People Ops): Sabbatical eligibility is unchanged. Carryover days are separate from sabbatical accruals.

time-off-bot: [auto] Request created: #REQ-20260301-8741 — Maya (People Ops) — same-day-autoapprove pilot note

Jason K: Thanks, sounds solid. Any comms for managers with tips on spotting misuse?

Maya (People Ops): We'll send a short manager guide and a 15-min drop-in office hours next Tue 11am PT. Also adding a tiny dashboard in Manager Console to flag patterns (3+ same-day auto-approves in 60 days).

Harper: Will this increase payroll adjustments? Curious about downstream ops.

Maya (People Ops): Should be minimal — managers confirm retro if complexity arises. Ops will get a weekly digest for the first quarter to spot any processing issues.

Jason K: :thumbsup:

Maya (People Ops): Link to the FAQ and the new request form: https://intra.redwood/people-ops/pto-updates (doc link). Ping me DM for edge cases. :sparkles:
